entries.dialogueText: "Yes?"

entries.title: Narrator: "The door opened, and Pabel graceful..."
entries.dialogueText: The door opened, and Pabel gracefully stepped in.

entries.dialogueText: "You said you wanted to be woken up at this time, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: "It's nice to see a familiar face."

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I did. It's best to get a head start while the day's still young."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's good to see you, Pabel.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's good to see you, Pabel."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew this day would come, but it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew this day would come, but it still feels odd having you wait on me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where's my newspaper?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where's my newspaper?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What nerve. Barge in on me again l..."
entries.dialogueText: "What nerve. Barge in on me again like that, and I'll have your head."

entries.dialogueText: The corner of Pabel's mouth twitched. He responded calmly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel blinked. He responded calmly."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel blinked. He responded calmly.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I wasn't informed you wanted one,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wasn't informed you wanted one, Your Majesty. I'll make sure to bring you the Herald every morning going forward."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You, too.""
entries.dialogueText: "You, too."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You had better get used to it. Eve..."
entries.dialogueText: "You had better get used to it. Everyone answers to you now."

entries.menuText: "Sorry, I couldn't resist. How are you, Pabel?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I mean it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I mean it."

entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel paused for a second, then res..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel paused for a second, then responded with composure.

entries.dialogueText: "I'm fine, Your Majesty. Wonderful, actually."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Indeed. You've got a packed schedu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. You've got a packed schedule ahead of you today."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""It won't happen again, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "It won't happen again, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""They're just getting it ready for..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're just getting it ready for you downstairs now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel nodded.

entries.dialogueText: Pabel leveled his gaze at me, his manner calm.

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, no, I was joking. How are you,..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. See that you do.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good. See that you do."

entries.dialogueText: In the eastern dining room, an enormous breakfast spread had been laid out.

entries.dialogueText: My mother was already sitting at the table, digging a spoon into a single grapefruit half.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Really? That's all you're eating?""
entries.dialogueText: "Really? That's all you're eating?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good morning, Mother.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good morning, Mother."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're supposed to rise when the K..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're supposed to rise when the King enters the room."
entries.menuText: "You're supposed to rise when the King enters the room."

entries.dialogueText: Despite the early hour, my mother was already in her full makeup. She dabbed at her lips with a napkin.

entries.dialogueText: "Isn't it a lovely morning?"

entries.dialogueText: "I nearly got lost on the way here. Grandma, why didn't you tell me this place had such a big library?"

entries.dialogueText: "Not too many of those. The sweeter the taste, the wider the waist. Don't you agree, Romus?"

entries.dialogueText: "It's a special occasion. Our diet can start tomorrow."

entries.dialogueText: "You know that I'm 18 now."

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it's time you started taking on more responsibilities."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "Exactly!"

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You always were a poetic type.""

entries.dialogueText: "My grandmother Queen Lyza didn't get her wisdom from serving on her father's council."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Greatness is something you're born..."
entries.dialogueText: "Greatness is something you're born with, my daughter. You can't glean it off of others."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My grandmother's achievements were..."
entries.dialogueText: "My grandmother's achievements weren't as noteworthy as everyone says. She just happened to be in the right place at the right time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You shouldn't have to worry about..."
entries.dialogueText: "You shouldn't have to worry about living up to anyone's legacy. You're great in your own right."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""That's not fair. She was already q..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not fair. She was already queen by the time she was my age."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Queen Lyza herself would disagree...."
entries.dialogueText: "Queen Lyza herself would disagree. That's why she worked so hard to improve educational opportunities for women."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""That's what some people say, yes...."
entries.dialogueText: "That's what some people say, yes. But I've read all her essays. She was a true visionary."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""That's very kind of you, Father. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's very kind of you, Father. But Lyza was the most beloved queen in our history. Of course people will compare me to her."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You're getting ahead of yourself,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're getting ahead of yourself, sweetheart. The crown is on your father's head right now, not yours."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me sharply."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me sharply.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""And what your father needs is for..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what your father needs is for your lovely little face to be seen at balls and ribbon-cutting ceremonies, not hidden behind council doors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your grandmother's right, Vina. As..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your grandmother's right, Vina. As the princess, it's up to you to serve as the ultimate example of beauty and grace in this country."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now, Mother. We both know Vina is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, Mother. We both know Vina is much more than a pretty face."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's an outdated image of a prin..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's an outdated image of a princess, isn't it? If Vina wants to get involved in politics, I don't see why I shouldn't let her."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is true that you'll learn more..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is true that you'll learn more about how the world works by being out in it, not by shadowing me."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Listen to both of you! I need to l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen to both of you! I need to learn how to govern the country, not just symbolize it."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Going to balls won't teach me how..."
entries.dialogueText: "Going to balls won't teach me how decrees are made, or how to negotiate with foreign leaders. Only time served on the council will do that."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I do recognize my duty to represen..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do recognize my duty to represent Rizia in public. But I need to learn how to govern the country, not just represent it."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You want to spend the best years o..."
entries.dialogueText: "You want to spend the best years of your life cooped up in that den of snakes?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The council isn't some wise, all-k..."
entries.dialogueText: "The council isn't some wise, all-knowing entity. Everyone on it is only looking after their own house and their own stature."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""And God help you if you get in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "And God help you if you get in the way of either of those."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My councilors represent many cumul..."
entries.dialogueText: "My councilors represent many cumulative decades of experience. I would not discount their wisdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have always found it odd that we..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have always found it odd that we entrust the country's direction to a handful of privileged nobles."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father may have allowed his cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father may have allowed his council to run roughshod over him. I will not make that mistake."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's enough, Mother. This is my..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's enough, Mother. This is my decision to make."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'm only trying to be helpful. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm only trying to be helpful. But you're right, of course. Go on."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If choosing when to ignore the cou..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And besides, if choosing when to i..."
entries.dialogueText: "And besides, if choosing when to ignore the council will be part of my future duties, I need to learn how to do that too."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I promise, it'll be like I'm not e..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise, it'll be like I'm not even there. And I'll step out in public as much as I can."
